extDesc.message: A hub for Mamorukun, Osamukun, and Unagasukun. Switch between the three extensions with tabs in one side panel.

settingsNote.message: Choose which extensions appear as tabs. The ID fields normally stay empty: fill one in only when you want to embed a build with a different ID, such as a development version (you can find IDs at chrome://extensions). Clear the field to go back to the store version.

noticeSub.message: The extension is either not installed or not yet updated to a version that supports embedding in Matomerukun. Please make sure it is up to date.

toastPickOne.message: Select at least one extension to show

toastNoBrowserWindow.message: No browser window to return to

toastSidePanelFailed.message: Could not open the side panel
